answer_4.quote: Human evaluation focuses on three aspects: 1) Accuracy: the aspect evaluates whether the generated answers are correct and free from factual errors. 2) Specificity: this aspect measures whether the responses are directly related to the specific issues raised in the question, providing clear and targeted answers rather than generalized responses. 3) Adoptability: this aspect assesses whether the responses generated by the model are practically useful and can be directly provided to users.
answer_4.guideline: Each dimension is rated on a scale of 1-5, with 5 being the highest score.
